title: Auditory oddball comparison (Optimum-1, Learning-oddball, and the local–global paradigm)
description: Raw EEG recordings from 15 participants who each completed three auditory oddball sequences: the Optimum-1 paradigm for mismatch negativity (MMN), a learning-oddball paradigm for P3b, and the local–global paradigm for local and global effects. The dataset supports comparison of within-individual sensitivity of MMN and P3b effects across specialized oddball sequences and the local–global paradigm. Corrected event files, stimulation sequence definitions and stimulus presentation code are included.
methods_description: Each participant completed all three auditory sequences consecutively in one EEG session, with order varying between participants. EEG was sampled at 2500 Hz (5000 Hz for participant 13). Stimulation was run with Psychtoolbox. Triggers skipped by the recording system were interpolated from Psychtoolbox event timestamps, and the corrected event samples are provided in the _events files. The local–global sequence was recorded in two runs (three runs for participant 5, who needed an extra break).
